passages.quote:
This code and the legislation permitting electronic and workplace voting methods will come into force on 25 August 2026.

This code of practice provides practical guidance on electronic balloting and workplace balloting for the following statutory trade union ballots:

industrial action ballots

union elections

ballots on union political funds

ballots on amalgamations of unions

ballots on transfers of engagements between trade union

The code also applies to the use of workplace balloting for industrial action ballots.
